We wait for London to pull price back under today's open price (1.10041), then buy when a 5-minute candle closes back above it. If price closes below 1.09912 instead, we stand aside.

Stopped: scenario B played out

The buy triggered at 07:20 (1.10078) after a half-pip dip under today's open. Price never got above the 07:00 high 1.10112. It based at 1.09944 at 08:00, chopped for two hours, then the dollar pushed up again from 10:00. The stop went at 10:50 and the euro made its London low at 1.09860 at 11:55.

The first dip under the open was too small to be the real stop-hunt. Buying the reclaim put the entry 13 pips above where price later based, with the dollar still strong at its 20-day high.

ICT note: week not set and the dollar in premium but still bid: the overnight sweep of the pair's 20-day low gave a bounce, not a reversal. The pound led all morning, so the euro was the weaker pair to buy.

In plain English

London got this morning's buy wrong: the euro was sold from 1.10112 to 1.09860. Two lows now sit side by side, 1.09854 overnight and 1.09860 in London, with stops resting under them.

We do not buy here. We wait for New York to push through those lows, then buy only if a 5-minute candle closes back above 1.09854. No sweep, no trade.

The trader's view

  • Dollar index 103.63 (synthetic), above its open 103.521 and at 0.97 of its 20-day range. It is 7 points from Monday's high 103.698 and the weekly sell zone 103.700 - 103.789.
  • The pound is the stronger one (EUR/GBP under its open) and held its London low 1.31851 while the euro made new lows. The euro carries the idea because its lows sit exactly on the dollar's level.
  • News (UK time): 13:30 US retail sales, no entry 13:15 - 13:45; the first run is usually the false one. 14:15 industrial production, 15:00 NAHB.

ICT breakdown

  • Bias: reversal buy, only after the raid. EUR/USD is under its whole 20-day range; the dollar is in deep premium. The day's flow is against it: Grade B.
  • Model: New York raid and reverse. Dollar into 103.700 - 103.789, euro under 1.09854 into the monthly bull FVG 1.09540 - 1.09854. CISD = 5m close back above 1.09854.
  • DOL: 1h bear FVG 1.09956 - 1.09978 and 15m bear FVG 1.09965 - 1.10007, then today's open 1.10041.
  • London: Judas up at 07:00 (1.10112), then down all session. Week: not set. SMT: pound holding 1.31851 while the euro breaks down. GH5: 3/5.

New York review

Plan A: raid, reclaim, both targets

The 13:30 data ran the euro's lows to 1.09671 while the dollar index hit 103.791, the top of its weekly sell zone. The 14:05 candle closed back above 1.09854 at 1.09897: buy. Target 1 went at 15:15 and target 2 at 15:40, when price ran to 1.10098, the overnight high.

Risk24.6p

What to learn from this All levels

Waiting for the lows to be taken first turned a losing morning idea into a clean afternoon one. The entry came late: the close back above the level was already 4 pips up, so the first target was 6 pips away against a 25-pip stop. The retest of 1.09855 - 1.09873 was the better fill.
